observed: RstLoader splits a reStructuredText file at its headings on Linux and macOS. On Windows the same file, whose lines end in a plain line feed, comes back as one single section. In the store test suite on Windows 17 tests fail and 1 test errors; on Linux none do.
gold_fix: Split with preg_split('/\R/', $content) and join with "\n".
